basis: Defining demyelination, ichthyosis and coagulation defects; optic atrophy/neuritis in 80-99%. Immune mechanism omitted because of the four-axis cap.
Isolated impaired sperm motility and male infertility; no endocrine or other axis involvement established.
Inherited structural skeletal myopathy. Respiratory muscle weakness does not establish direct lung disease across this umbrella.
Premature fusion of metopic and sagittal skull sutures; neurologic injury is not established as a common defining feature.
Mechanical obstruction of the afferent jejunal loop. Associated pancreatic or biliary complications do not establish common additional organ damage.
Familial epilepsy with developmental impairment and ataxia; no independent muscle or other organ damage established.
T-cell deficiency and lymphopenia define the disorder; nail dystrophy affects 10/25 (40%). Pneumonia affects 20%, below threshold.
Retinal malignancy extending beyond the eye; no particular additional organ is established as involved in at least 30%.
Peroxisomal disorder with common neurologic, hepatic and retinal injury across the Zellweger spectrum (>30%); hearing loss omitted by cap. Severity varies.
Acute myeloid malignancy of marrow and blood; no additional organ damage established above threshold.
Developmental disability and epilepsy define it; hip dysplasia, hemivertebrae and clavicular pseudarthrosis each reported in 1/2. Constipation alone does not establish GI damage.
Noonan cardiac/skeletal phenotype; intellectual disability 5/5 and strabismus 3/5. Esophageal anomalies 2/5 omitted by cap; melanoma is a separate disease.
Inherited thrombotic microangiopathy with hemolysis and thrombocytopenia; renal dysfunction is a major diagnostic feature. Stroke 21%; TIA does not establish lasting damage.
Developmental disability and scalp aplasia/hair abnormalities in 3/3; urethral malformation (hypospadias) in 3/3. Minor digit dysmorphism alone does not establish functional damage.
Meningioma occupying lung; definition includes primary pulmonary tumors, so CNS involvement cannot be assumed across the concept.
Inherited familial brain degeneration causing progressive dementia.
Childhood tumor arising from the brain's choroid plexus.
Inherited widespread cutaneous lentigines; definition explicitly excludes associated noncutaneous abnormalities.
Usually infectious inflammation of the mastoid air-cell mucosa, part of the middle-ear system; destructive bone involvement is not required.
Lysosomal storage with dysostosis (~90%); intellectual disability and corneal opacity 80-99%. Pleural abnormalities omitted by cap; hepatomegaly alone does not prove dysfunction.
Coenzyme A metabolic defect causing brain iron-associated degeneration; retinal dystrophy and optic pallor occur in 30-79%. Dysphagia and stiffness reflect neurologic dysfunction.
Candida bloodstream infection; bloodstream presence alone does not establish blood-cell, marrow or coagulation disease.
Villous epithelial adenoma occurs predominantly in the gastrointestinal tract; urinary and vaginal sites are uncommon alternatives.
Ovarian malignancy is outside the axes; skeletal muscle differentiation does not establish skeletal muscle origin or endocrine dysfunction.
Clonal myeloid malignancy of marrow and blood; gingival infiltration is recognized, but involvement in at least 30% is not established.
